text:
Eurotrash,

So I see that you are looking at the engulf of the flag limit to short up at the source of the engulf you have marked as supply. My question is what you have marked as free space. I have never seen anybody mark free space as a PAZ, yet that appears to be what you have done. Is that correct? So basically the PAZ is the free space or the pole in between flags?

Thanks,

author: Eurotrash
text:
Hey Hotochin,

PAZ's are for me a zone which when enetered price will want to get to the other side, be it compression, stacked supply/demand or a zone where price travelled through with very few hickups along the way.

I hope I was clear
